objective: Global can create and run a capable independent team through Hollywood, with original work, identities and attributable results preserved.
milestone: N1 — full native single-host work loop

currentEvidence.sharedToolCore: NativeTools now owns the existing handlers, effect journals and original-operation recovery. Connector and purpose NativeToolSession use that same implementation.
currentEvidence.limits: The installed purpose writer currently exposes native read tools only. General mutation transport remains closed. No Global-created team or complete native capability parity is claimed.

sourceFindings.finding: The prototype writes a context-work claim/running state directly; the existing full native claim path rejects configured purpose agents. Restore one shared admission path rather than presenting metadata as native executor admission.
Explicit captured executor ownership is now factored. Actual installed guardian approval, reservation, attachment and independent observation still need to recognize the purpose services.

Current native source checks pin a delivery to one native turn. The accepted per-turn purpose receipts already preserve original ownership; extend effect validation coherently across successive turns without fake delivery generations.
Role revision is frozen by the prototype's configuration join. Coherent role refresh must retain context/history and accepted work, while current permissions remain independently enforced.
Internal context work is a handoff, not formal hb_work acceptance/report/review. Restore the existing canonical workflow and cooperation paths; keep these domains explicit.

nextImplementation: Connect accepted purpose work to the existing claim/admission, execution journal and independently observed executor lifecycle. Preserve the original source, delivery and ownership generation.

Extend installed service approval/provisioning for the purpose layout and verify actual model/account, workspace, admin, Git and SSH access. Map approved guardians and native processes exactly; keep reader/responder recovery independent of writer drainage.

Keep work ownership, resident process/resource ownership and inference capacity separate. A confirmed wait for a peer must not hold a model permit that prevents that peer from running. Unknown original turns remain held; do not fix deadlock by choosing an arbitrary slot count.

Bind native tool/effect provenance to the accepted purpose execution and independently live executor. Enable the existing administration, workflow/review, cooperation/editing and questions only through that common path.
Preserve responder-owned outward communication, handle scoped reader corrections/findings with version/read barriers, and refresh responsibilities without replacing the agent identity.

processLayout.status: Actual private three-unit metadata prototype qualified; root installer/service enrollment integration pending.
processLayout.rationale: Each purpose can have its own Linux service/cgroup and native history while retaining one Hollywood agent identity. A writer group can drain without reader/responder processes masquerading as remaining execution. These are LAX runtime units, with no new semantic orchestration service.
processLayout.remaining: Apply an aggregate agent resource budget and exact approved launcher mapping. Validate scheduling capacity separately from resident process identity.

acceptance: A single ordinary human request makes Global create a room and peer through its native tools and provision the real peer itself. The peer performs useful cooperative editing/work, a relevant correction/finding is handled, Global independently verifies/reviews the artifact and its responder reports to the original audience. Then exercise the same work through restart, Stop and compaction before user rollout.
validationPriority: Use actual models and the authenticated user/agent APIs for the end-state journey. Use bounded deterministic checks for identity, receipts, admission and cancellation; no broad edge-case campaign before this capable work loop exists.
rollout: Private candidate only until that end state and environment readiness pass. Keep production services, phone pairings, queued work, active typing/voice and deliberately stopped sessions intact.
